## Biography

Official biography page: https://dzhumadilov.com/bio.html

Daniyar Dzhumadilov is a stand-up comedian and performer from Kazakhstan. He performs in Russian and is known for live audience interaction, strong improvisation, and original observations about everyday life. His shows often combine stand-up comedy with live musical moments. In English his name is also spelled Daniyar Jumadilov and Daniyar Zhumadilov. The official website for the artist and all tour information is dzhumadilov.com.
